2フォース消費して 戦士キャラクターに配備する。2フォース使って 起動する。運命数を引く。キャラクターは、（運命数＋1）＞能力値ならば命中。ビークルには、（運命数＋1）＞回避値か装甲値ならば命中する。

Title — Blaster Rifle (Dark).

Lore — A stormtrooper-issue BlasTech E-11 blaster rifle. The stock folds so it can be used as a pistol or a rifle. It holds 100 shots and is limited to military use.

Game text — Use 2 Force to deploy on a warrior character. Use 2 Force to fire. Draw destiny. A character is hit if destiny +1 > ability. A vehicle is hit if destiny +1 > maneuver or armor.

Comparison with the English printing

Hit checks use ability, maneuver or armor rather than defense value. No creature. Firing is 起動する. Lore 折畳式 and military-only 100 shots. White border.[2]

Title

2X-3KPR（トゥエックス）

Card Text

「夜間状態」の場合、同じ場所の自分の反乱軍、エイリアンは、すべて戦闘力が＋２される。「水耕ステーション」のカードと同じ場所にあると、さらに耐：損耗＜３を得る。[1]

整備点検用の単純作業ドロイド。各所に配備された警戒センサーや非常灯、電磁フェンスなどを遠隔起動させる。レリモア・ドロイズ社製のサーバント・ドロイド。[1]

Lore: A simple labor droid used for maintenance and inspection. It remotely activates warning sensors, emergency lights, electromagnetic fences, and similar equipment installed throughout an area. A servant droid manufactured by Lerrimore Droids.

操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に＋3。密輸屋ではないが、ケッセル・ランを行える。耐：損耗<3。[2]

Lore

モグリのパイロット。無資格の宇宙船技術者。モス・アイズリーに秘密研究室を持つ。ハン・ソロの持つケッセル・ランの記録を破った豪語した。オビ＝ワンに出会った後、改心する。[2]

Title: BoShek.[2]

Comparison with the English printing: The Japanese explicitly says he is not a smuggler; the English says he may make a Kessel Run in place of a smuggler. Brainiac is a Light Character from Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy.

Title

ブレイニアック[1]

Card Text

*戦闘力＝√3 (X－Y) +2 (A－B) +π（最低でも戦闘力＝1）。X＝ダークサイドの手札の枚数、Y＝ライトサイドの手札の枚数、A＝場に出ているカードのダークアイコンの合計数、B＝場に出ているカードのライトアイコンの合計数、π＝3.141592653589793238462643383...である。[1]

Lore

ボシェックはこのシニティーンの男性に“ブレイニアック（頭でっかち）”というあだ名をつけた。その名にふさわしく、彼はハイパースペースの座標を自分の頭で計算できる。レイアの脱獄作戦も、彼が立案していたらさぞかし…[1]

Translation of Japanese Text

Title: Brainiac.

Card text: *Power = √3 (X−Y) +2 (A−B) + π (power is at least 1). X is the Dark Side hand size. Y is the Light Side hand size. A is the total Dark icons on table. B is the total Light icons on table. π is 3.141592653589793238462643383…

Lore: Boshek gave this Sanyassan male the nickname Brainiac (big-headed). True to the name, he can calculate hyperspace coordinates in his head. If only he had been the one to plan Leia's escape…

Comparison with the English printing: The Japanese lore glosses the nickname as 頭でっかち.

Notes

Brainiac (Japanese Reflections II Foil) is a Japanese-language foil printing of Brainiac. Decipher released it in Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy in January 2001. The ordinary Japanese expansion printing is Brainiac (Japanese). Complete Card List v4 lists checklist R56 at rarity SR. Collector R-numbers are checklist references, not GEMP blueprint IDs.[2][3][1]

This is a 5×7 promo with no regular-size version. For the other different-size cards, see Oversized cards.

•Mara Jade & •Corran Horn & •Talon Karrde is a 5×7 Light Character promotional card made by Decipher in 2001. It shows Mara Jade, Corran Horn, and Talon Karrde together in a single photograph. It was given to customers who spent $20 or more at the Decipher store at conventions.[1][2] Unlike the other oversized cards it has no regular-size counterpart: the Collecting Encyclopedia describes it as a "5” x 7” card, not available as a standard sized card."[2]

Card Text

The game-text box is blank. Decipher's announcement listed it as "No Game Text (you'll need room for autographs!)"[3]

Lore

Each driven by a dubious past, these scoundrels now plan for the greater good of the New Republic. Found in the strangest places.

Notes
Stats. Destiny 3, Power 8, Ability 5, Deploy 8, Forfeit 9, with Pilot and Warrior icons and Force-Sensitive on the printed card. Radio Free Decipher gave the same numbers in its announcement.[3]
Announcement. Radio Free Decipher (22 June 2001), reported the next day by Yarua on TheForce.net, said Decipher would make the card available at its summer 2001 convention appearances (Origins, San Diego, GenCon, Wizard World, and DragonCon) so fans could get autographs from Shannon Baksa (Mara Jade), Michael A. Stackpole (Corran Horn), and Timothy Zahn (Talon Karrde). It listed the card as "Corran Horn & Mara Jade & Talon Karrde".[3]
Photography. The three had been shot together when Decipher photographed the individual Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy cards, including the Corran Horn and Talon Karrde premiums.[3] The Mara Jade side of the shoot is covered at Mara Jade: Flesh and Blood.
Back. Rebel Alliance symbol, decipher.com, and starwars.com.[4]
Catalog. The Star Wars Collectors Archive lists it as item 11260, "CCG, Show Premium, 5x7", year 2001, licensee Decipher.[5]
Back of the 5×7.[4]
The 5×7 signed by Baksa, Michael A. Stackpole, and Timothy Zahn.[4]

Title

アナキンのライトセーバー[1]

Card Text

能力値＞3のスカイウォーカーにフォースを消費せずに配備する。キャラクターがいる場所のフォース消耗に＋1。フォースを消費せずに起動する。キャラクターを目標とする。運命数を2枚引く。運命数の合計＞能力値なら、キャラクターに命中し、目標は没収値＝0となる。[1]

Lore

アナキン・スカイウォーカーが作ったライトセーバー。ルークに手渡すべく、オビ＝ワンが保管していた。[1]

Translation of Japanese Text

Title: Anakin's Lightsaber.

Card text: Deploy without spending Force on a Skywalker with ability > 3. Add 1 to Force drains at the location where the character is. Use without spending Force. Target a character. Draw two destiny. If total destiny > ability, the character is hit and the target's forfeit becomes 0.

Lore: A lightsaber made by Anakin Skywalker. Obi-Wan kept it in order to hand it over to Luke.

Comparison with the English printing: The Japanese states the Force-drain bonus and the free weapon use in separate sentences. The foil writes オビ＝ワン where the Hoth Japanese printing writes オビーワン.

Notes

Anakin's Lightsaber (Japanese Reflections III Foil) is a Japanese-language foil printing of Anakin's Lightsaber. Decipher released it in Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty in October 2001. The ordinary Japanese expansion printing is Anakin's Lightsaber (Japanese). Complete Card List v4 lists checklist R98 at rarity SR. Collector R-numbers are checklist references, not GEMP blueprint IDs.[2][3][1]

Title

トニカ・シスターズ（姉妹）

Card Text

2ターンに1回、自分の支配フェイズに、2フォース消費して運命数を2回引くことができる。どちらかの運命数が2なら、場にある武器を2つかアイテムを2つ盗むことができる。トニカ姉妹は何らかのカードの対象になる場合には1人のキャラクターとして扱われるが、移動には2倍のフォースがかかる。[1]

Lore

双子の盗賊にして詐欺師、スパイにしてダブル・エージェント。ブレアとセニの姉妹は持ち前の色香を発揮して社会の底辺に住むカモたちを操ってきた。[1]

Translation of Japanese Text

Title: Tonnika Sisters.

Card text: Once every 2 turns, during your control phase, use 2 Force to draw 2 destiny. If either destiny is 2, steal 2 weapons or 2 devices on table. When targeted, the sisters count as one character, but moving them costs double Force.

Lore: Twin thieves, con artists, spies, and double agents. Brea and Senni use their charm on marks at the fringe of society.

Comparison with the English printing: The Japanese treats the sisters as one character when targeted, with double move cost.

Notes

Japanese-language printing of Tonnika Sisters in Premiere (Japanese).[2][1]
